dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Yes, I used to be an adventurer, but not now.

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: After stumbling into this Mirage during a desert adventure, I decided to make it my home, and live a peaceful and stable life!

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Since then, I haven't left. No more adventures...
